description: MUTATES OwnerRez data: creates a new guest (contact). OwnerRez API: POST /v2/guests (JSON). Emails/phones/addresses are arrays of objects — pass them via the `fields` passthrough (e.g. email_addresses:[{address:"a@b.com"}]). Returns the created guest.

fields.description: Additional documented OwnerRez fields to send in the JSON write body (merged with the typed fields above).

opt_out_marketing_email.description: Opt this guest out of marketing email.

opt_out_marketing_sms.description: Opt this guest out of marketing SMS.

name: create_guest
title: Create a guest
